name: VisualBoyAdvance-M
description: WinSparkle/Sparkle auto-updater; macOS EdDSA-pinning line is commented out and Windows never calls any key API — no payload verification enforced. CDN compromise = RCE.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Targeted source read supports this narrow assessment: WinSparkle points to an HTTPS appcast, with an HTTP fallback in the NO_HTTPS build; no public signing key is configured in this wrapper path.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact behavior or upstream configuration.
Where verification is delegated to an external framework/package, that implementation was not vendored and remains unresolved.

original_evidence.text: | VisualBoyAdvance-M | https://github.com/visualboyadvance-m/visualboyadvance-m | 830bb077 / 2026-08-23 | Y | Y | Y | https (Windows fallback to http on pre-Vista only) | N (no manifest signature scheme; appcast is plain XML over HTTPS) | none enforced (EdDSA pinning present in code but commented out) | unpinned / not configured | Win: `src/wx/autoupdater/wxmsw/autoupdater.cpp:15-19` — WinSparkle points at `https://data.visualboyadvance-m.org/appcast.xml` (falls back to plain `http://` for `_WIN32_WINNT < 0x0600`, same file lines 12-17); `winsparkle-wrapper.h` exposes no `win_sparkle_set_public_key`/DSA API call anywhere in the wrapper or its call sites — no signature key is ever configured, so WinSparkle performs no payload signature check, only HTTPS transport. macOS: `src/wx/CMakeLists.txt:1606` fetches the Sparkle framework itself via `FetchContent` (pinned SHA256, fine) but `src/wx/CMakeLists.txt:1636` — `#set(CCS7 defaults write ... Info.plist SUPublicEDKey -string "${PUBLIC_KEY}")` — **the line that would set the pinned EdDSA public key is commented out**, and the corresponding `add_custom_command` invocation of `${CCS7}` is also commented out (line 1642). `autoupdater.cpp` (macOS) just calls `addAppcastURL("https://data.visualboyadvance-m.org/appcast.xml")` with no key material. Net effect: downloaded update .zip/.dmg is fetched over HTTPS and auto-installed with no cryptographic payload verification pinned in the app — a compromise of `data.visualboyadvance-m.org` or its CDN/TLS chain is sufficient for RCE (Sparkle's fallback matching-code-signature check may still apply on macOS via Apple code-signing, but that is not configured/verified in-repo, and Windows has no equivalent fallback at all). |
